facts.text: Functional safety addresses what happens if a component fails.
facts.quote: functional safety (what if a component fails)

facts.text: Safety of the intended functionality addresses cases where nothing fails but the system still gets something wrong.
facts.quote: safety of the intended functionality (what if nothing fails but the system still gets it wrong)

facts.text: A safety case is the document in which the safety argument is made.
facts.quote: the safety case, the document in which everything is argued
